reasoning_content:
Now run backend inside devcontainer. But it needs node_modules from /workspace (mounted). Actually dist is in /workspace/dist. Let me run the built backend inside devcontainer with node22 and the hosts available.

Stop the host-run backend first.

action.command: kill 42673 42675 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; pkill -f "dist/apps/startuphafen-backend/main.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; timeout 3 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5000" && echo "5000 still open" || echo "5000 closed"
